en: Changed the non-interactive first turn to still wait up to 2s for connecting MCP servers named by `--allowedTools` or an `mcp_tool` hook, even when `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS` is `0`
zh: 变更：非交互式首轮仍会最多等待 2 秒，以连接由 `--allowedTools` 或 `mcp_tool` hook 指定的 MCP 服务器，即使 `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS` 为 `0`
